description: B(mu -> e gamma) at the 2028 soft-broken viable points of viable_points_soft.json, over notebook 06's mu_3 grid and every lepton branch. One loop (h, A, H+- with e, mu, tau and massless nu) plus Barr-Zee (t, b under the vacuum-direction ansatz; tau computed; W; H+- with the h H+ H- trilinears). Per point: the least-constrained configuration and its breakdown (|A_L|^2+|A_R|^2 of each piece alone, GeV^-4).

conventions.quark_couplings: y_qq(h_i) = kappa_i m_q / v, none for A (ansatz)
